newsitem.title: LATVIA: BALTIC TRANSIT BANK APRIL PROFIT 260,000 LATS.
newsitem.headline: BALTIC TRANSIT BANK APRIL PROFIT 260,000 LATS.

text.p: Baltic Transit Bank, the 7th largest bank in Latvia by way of assets, said on Tuesday that its April profit came to 260,834 lats after making a profit of 507,000 lats in the first quarter of the year.
The bank also said in a statement that its assets rose in April to 59.11 million lats from 54.41 million lats.
Its own capital grew in the first three months of the year rose by 600,000 lats to 8.27 million lats, the bank said.
Its deposits in April came to 32.7 million lats versus 34.6 million at the end of the first quarter and its loan portfolio was 20.2 million lats.
